decision.message: Adding a humidity sensor alongside the existing pressure sensor on the esp32_bmp280_v1 board family is unsupported, as the board design and family specifications include only the BMP280 pressure sensor and do not provide for adding a humidity sensor.

clauses.text: Include a humidity sensor on the PCB alongside the pressure sensor and controller.
clauses.reason: The existing esp32_bmp280_v1 board family includes only a BMP280 pressure sensor which exposes die temperature for compensation but does not include a humidity sensor. No additional sensors beyond the BMP280 are supported on this board family.
